deviations.what: The two ObjectHeaders bind the fixed records {/ProductCollection/0} and {/ProductCollection/1}. The port seeds both records' bound fields at the default-model root under a per-header prefix and binds them absolutely, so both ObjectHeader.binding attributes are dropped and the composed attribute texts read the same values.

The last ObjectAttribute of each header is the literal 'www.sap.com' with active="true", which structural-diff reports against the {Description} attribute of the same control because it compares the attribute across all four - both texts are present, in the original's order.
